# pve_sdn_fabric_node (Resource)

One node's participation in an SDN fabric (endpoint, interfaces, peers, role).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pve_sdn_fabric_node" "example" {
fabric_id = "CHANGE_ME"
interfaces = "CHANGE_ME"
node_id = "CHANGE_ME"
protocol = "openfabric"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_id` (String) Identifier for SDN fabrics
- `interfaces` (List of String) <array>
- `node_id` (String) Identifier for nodes in an SDN fabric
- `protocol` (String) Type of configuration entry in an SDN Fabric section config One of: `openfabric`, `ospf`, `wireguard`, `bgp`.

### Optional

- `allowed_ips` (List of String) A list of IPs that are routable via this node in the WireGuard fabric.
- `delete` (List of String) <array>
- `endpoint` (String) The endpoint used for connecting to this node.
- `ip` (String) IPv4 address for this node
- `ip6` (String) IPv6 address for this node
- `lock_token` (String) the token for unlocking the global SDN configuration
- `peers` (List of String) <array>
- `public_key` (String) The public key for the external node.
- `role` (String) The role of this node in the WireGuard fabric. One of: `internal`, `external`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Opaque identifier: fabric_id/node_id (also the `terraform import` format).
